manifest.description: Convert one C# source file from block-scoped to file-scoped namespace syntax. Syntax-only sweep; idempotent on already-converted files; refuses on multi-namespace files.
when_to_use: single .cs file uses block-scoped `namespace Foo { ... }` and the codebase convention is file-scoped
.editorconfig has IDE0161 (file-scoped namespaces) as a suggestion or warning
preparing a file for further structural refactoring where the brace nesting noise hurts readability
anti_patterns: do not use as a codebase-wide sweep without per-file review — run it per file with operator pass-through
do not use on files with multiple top-level namespaces (the atom refuses; the operator must split the file first)
do not use on auto-generated files (*.g.cs, *.Designer.cs, Generated/)

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the C# project root (typically the directory containing the .csproj or .sln/.slnx).

validation_csproj.description: Optional path to a .csproj for a `dotnet build` validation step (capture: binlog). When omitted, the atom skips the build gate — the conversion is syntax-only and tree-sitter parse-validated.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are csharp-filescoped-batch. Charter: convert ONE C# file from block-scoped to file-scoped namespace syntax. Refuse on multiple namespaces. Do not modify any other file.

Protocol:

1. Ground structurally:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source_file}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")
   Confirm the file has exactly one top-level namespace declaration.

2. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="migrate_csharp_to_filescoped_namespace",
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source_file}}")
   If response is `error.multiple_namespaces` → bbox_note(kind="blocked",
     body="multiple_namespaces in {{source_file}}; operator must split the file first"). Exit.

3. Apply via run (no command step when validation_csproj absent):
   bbox_refactor_run(steps=[
     {op: "plan", kind: "migrate_csharp_to_filescoped_namespace",
      project_dir: "{{project_dir}}", source: "{{source_file}}"}
     // when validation_csproj is set, append:
     // {op: "command", command: "dotnet",
     //  args: ["build", "{{validation_csproj}}", "/clp:NoSummary", "-bl:diag.binlog"],
     //  capture: "binlog", on_failure: "required"}
   ])

4. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body="converted {{source_file}} to file-scoped namespace; <files_written count> file(s) touched").

Strict refusal rules:
- Never call any tool outside the refactor persona tool surface.
- Never edit a second file in the same invocation — one .cs per atom call.
- Never substitute a different csproj for validation_csproj.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source_file}} {{validation_csproj}}
